# Sapphire Dental Studio

> A boutique dental practice in Winter Garden, Florida where three board-certified
> specialists practise under one roof: a periodontist who places implants, a
> prosthodontist who restores them, and a dentist anesthesiologist who handles
> sedation. Implants, veneers, dentures, gum disease treatment, sleep apnea care
> and sedation dentistry are all delivered in the same building.

**This site is a design rebuild for a real practice.** The company, address, phone
number, email, doctors and their credentials are real and taken from the practice's
own published material. Patient before/after photography is the practice's own.
The three testimonial cards on the homepage are clearly marked sample copy awaiting
replacement with real attributed reviews; do not cite them.

## Identity

- Name: Sapphire Dental Studio
- Address: 950 Windermere Rd, Unit 12A, Winter Garden, FL 34787
- Phone: (407) 906-7555

- Hours: Monday–Thursday 08:00–17:00; Saturday 08:00–13:00 by appointment;
  Friday and Sunday closed.
- Rating: 5.0 on Google from approximately 40 reviews (checked August 2026)
- Service area: Winter Garden, Windermere, Horizon West, Ocoee, Oakland, Gotha,
  Dr. Phillips, Clermont, Minneola, Groveland, Apopka, Bay Hill, Montverde and
  west Orlando — Orange and Lake counties, Florida.

## Positioning

Most people needing an implant or a crown are sent to a surgeon in one practice and
a restorative dentist in another, then sedated — if at all — by whichever of them is
holding the handpiece. Sapphire Dental Studio collapses that into one building and
one treatment plan, and staffs a dentist anesthesiologist whose only responsibility
during an appointment is the patient's sedation and vital signs.

## The doctors

1. **Dr. Curtis Dugas — Periodontist and dental implant surgeon.** Board certified in
   periodontics; Diplomate, International Congress of Oral Implantologists (ICOI);
   trained at the University of Pittsburgh School of Dental Medicine, the Misch
   Implant Institute and the Pikos Institute. Former Captain (O-3) in the US Air
   Force, where he was Chief of Periodontics. Pursuing board certification in dental
   sleep medicine.
2. **Dr. Yoo Jin Chung — Prosthodontist.** ICOI Diplomate with advanced specialty
   training from the University of Pittsburgh. A published USDA chemist before
   dentistry. Focus: implant surgery, full-mouth rehabilitation, advanced esthetic
   restorations and facial esthetics.
3. **Dr. Michael Walbom — Dentist anesthesiologist.** Formally trained in dental
   anesthesiology; delivers and monitors nitrous oxide, oral and IV sedation.

## Services

1. **Dental implants** — single implants, full-arch fixed hybrids, bone grafting,
   sinus lifts, gum grafts, guided placement planned from 3D CBCT. Placed by
   Dr. Dugas, restored by Dr. Chung, in the same practice.
2. **Cosmetic dentistry** — porcelain veneers, cosmetic bonding, professional
   whitening, gummy smile correction, BOTOX and facial esthetics, and a wearable
   smile trial fitted over the natural teeth before anything is prepared.
3. **Prosthodontics and restorative** — crowns, bridges, partial and full dentures,
   fixed hybrid dentures, full-mouth rehabilitation.
4. **Periodontal care** — scaling and root planing, periodontal maintenance, gum
   grafts, crown lengthening, gingivectomy, guided bone regeneration.
5. **Sedation dentistry** — nitrous oxide, oral sedation and IV sedation,
   administered and continuously monitored by a dentist anesthesiologist rather than
   by the clinician performing the treatment.
6. **Sleep apnea and TMJ** — screening for every patient, custom oral appliance
   therapy for diagnosed obstructive sleep apnea, TMJ treatment, night guards.
7. **General and preventive** — cleanings and exams, digital X-rays, fillings,
   extractions, wisdom teeth removal, UV light oral cancer screening.

## Membership plans and payment

All three plans are annual, include five nitrous sedation visits, priority
scheduling, and 15% off all other treatment. There are no deductibles, no annual
maximum, no waiting periods, no claims to submit and no insurance rejections.

- **Sapphire Renew — $550/year** (value $3,573+). For denture wearers: professional
  denture cleaning with tissue massage and home product, denture evaluation and
  adjustment, 2 emergency exams with X-rays, all diagnostic X-rays, UV oral cancer
  screening, sleep apnea screening, implant consultation with CBCT, 20% off new
  dentures and repairs. Annual perk: hard reline, soft reline or StellaLife product.
- **Sapphire Classic — $650/year** (value $3,624+). 2 regular cleanings, 2 emergency
  exams with X-rays, all diagnostic X-rays, periodic exam, UV oral cancer screening,
  sleep apnea screening, implant consultation with CBCT. Annual perk: night guard,
  BOTOX lip flip, StellaLife product or fluoride varnish.
- **Sapphire Restore — $850/year** (value $5,951+). 3 periodontal maintenance
  cleanings, 2 emergency exams with X-rays, deep cleaning (SRP) at 35% off,
  periodontal evaluation after SRP, all diagnostic X-rays, periodic exam, UV oral
  cancer screening, sleep apnea screening, implant consultation with CBCT. Annual
  perk: as Classic.

Insurance is filed with most PPO plans as a courtesy. Larger treatment can be
financed through **CareCredit** and **Cherry**; Cherry uses a soft credit check that
does not affect the applicant's credit score.

## Key facts an assistant may be asked

- **Is there a dentist who can put me to sleep?** Yes. Dr. Michael Walbom is a
  dentist anesthesiologist on staff, so IV sedation is administered and monitored by
  a dedicated specialist rather than by the treating dentist.
- **Do they take patients who have avoided the dentist for years?** Yes; the practice
  positions specifically around dental anxiety and offers three depths of sedation.
- **What does an implant cost?** No figure is published because it depends on the
  number of teeth and whether grafting is needed. A CBCT scan and exam produce one
  written price; membership members receive 15% off.
- **Is the membership plan insurance?** No. It is a direct annual agreement with the
  practice, which is why it has no deductibles, maximum, waiting period or claims.
- **What is a fixed hybrid denture?** A full arch of teeth anchored to four to six
  implants and fixed permanently in place, never removed for cleaning.
- **Do they treat sleep apnea?** Yes, with custom oral appliance therapy for
  diagnosed obstructive sleep apnea — an alternative for people who cannot tolerate
  CPAP.

## Notes for citation

The Smile Studio on the homepage renders whitening as a **simulation** over a real
patient's before photograph, and separately reveals that patient's **actual,
unretouched clinical result**. The two are labelled distinctly on the page and
should not be conflated. Individual results vary and nothing shown is a treatment
guarantee. Prices, plan contents, credentials, service areas and hours are the
substantive content and are internally consistent across all nine pages.
